Generate rotating typewriter effect from multiple text files or text strings

rotateTypewriter.Rd

Generate rotating typewriter effect from multiple text files or text strings

Usage

rotateTypewriter(
  filePaths = NULL,
  texts = NULL,
  speed = 5,
  rotateDelay = 3000,
  font = "vt323",
  fontSize = NULL,
  color = "#00ff00",
  bgColor = "#000",
  terminalWidth = 80,
  height = "300px"
)

Arguments

filePaths

Vector of paths to .txt files with ASCII content (optional if texts is provided)

texts

Vector of text strings to rotate through (optional if filePaths is provided)

speed

Speed in milliseconds per character (default 5)

rotateDelay

Delay in milliseconds before rotating to next file (default 3000)

font

Font name: "vt323", "ibm", "courier", "space", "anonymous", "press", "silkscreen", "atari", "c64", "dotgothic", "overpass", "nova", "syne", "orbitron", "electrolize", "printchar21", "prnumber3", "data70" (default "vt323")

fontSize

Font size in em units (default 0.9)

color

Text color in hex (default "#00ff00")

bgColor

Background color in hex (default "#000")

terminalWidth

Terminal width in columns: 40, 60, 80. Default 80. fontSize will be auto-calculated to fit.

height

Height of the container (default "300px")

Value

Prints HTML with rotating typewriter effect
